name: Jamaica

flag.description: A gold diagonal cross (saltire) divides the flag into four triangles: green at top and bottom, black at hoist and fly.
flag.symbolism: Black represents the strength and creativity of the people, gold the sunlight and natural wealth, and green the land and hope.

hook: Jamaica: a golden X splitting black and green triangles, and the only national flag with no red, white or blue.
trivia: Jamaica's flag is the only current national flag that contains none of red, white or blue.
An earlier proposal with horizontal stripes was dropped because it looked too similar to the flag of Tanganyika.
